<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="1" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="21" y="18" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <rect x="329" y="10" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="336" y="8" width="4" height="10" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="343" y="6" width="4" height="12" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="17" x2="363" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="363" y1="11" x2="369" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="359" y1="15" x2="367" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="374" y="7" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="376" y="9" width="13" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="392" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,57 22,66 31,75" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="66" x2="43" y2="66" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">CREATE ACCOUNT</text>
    <line x1="22" y1="91" x2="368" y2="91" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="22" y="106" width="346" height="4" rx="2" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="22" y="106" width="173" height="4" rx="2" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="22" y="132" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">STEP 2 OF 4</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Birthday form -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="184" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">My birthday is</text>
    <text x="22" y="215" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">This helps us show you people in your age range.</text>

    <text x="22" y="260" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">DATE OF BIRTH</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="22" y="273" width="96" height="55" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
      <text x="70" y="307" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">MM</text>
      <line x1="35" y1="323" x2="105" y2="323" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
    <text x="128" y="308" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="20" fill="#D9D9D9">/</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="145" y="273" width="96" height="55" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
      <text x="193" y="307" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">DD</text>
      <line x1="158" y1="323" x2="228" y2="323" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
    <text x="251" y="308" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="20" fill="#D9D9D9">/</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="268" y="273" width="100" height="55" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
      <text x="318" y="307" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">YYYY</text>
      <line x1="281" y1="323" x2="355" y2="323" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>

    <circle cx="31" cy="357" r="8" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="31" y="361" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="47" y="361" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">You must be at least 18 years old to use Tinder.</text>
    <text x="22" y="383" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="300" fill="#939393">Your birthday will not be shown publicly.</text>

    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="90" y="418" width="210" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
      <text x="195" y="446" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="490" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can change this later in Settings.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- iOS numeric keypad -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="548" width="390" height="296" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="548" x2="390" y2="548" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="8" y="558" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="558" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="558" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="8" y="625" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="625" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="625" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="8" y="692" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="692" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="692" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="8" y="759" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="136" y="759" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
      <rect x="264" y="759" width="118" height="58" rx="5" fill="#FCFCFE"/>
    </g>

    <text x="67" y="584" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">1</text>
    <text x="195" y="584" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">2</text>
    <text x="323" y="584" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">3</text>
    <text x="195" y="601" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">ABC</text>

    <text x="67" y="651" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">4</text>
    <text x="195" y="651" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">5</text>
    <text x="323" y="651" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">6</text>
    <text x="195" y="668" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">JKL</text>

    <text x="67" y="718" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">7</text>
    <text x="195" y="718" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">8</text>
    <text x="323" y="718" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">9</text>
    <text x="195" y="735" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">WXYZ</text>

    <text x="195" y="785" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="25" fill="#000000">0</text>
    <text x="195" y="802" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">+</text>

    <g>
      <polyline points="314,783 327,783 327,792 314,792" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="314,783 308,787.5 314,792" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="316" y1="787.5" x2="334" y2="787.5" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    </g>

    <rect x="142" y="831" width="106" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
</svg>
